title: Plans and Dreams

story.title: Malika’s big plans
story.text: Malika is seventeen, and she has a lot of **plans** for the future! First, she**’s going to** **pass** her IELTS **exam** in March. She **works hard** every day to **improve her English**. Her **goal** is band 7. | After that, she **hopes** to **study abroad**. She **would like to** study business in Malaysia or Korea. “It **depends** on the price,” she says. “I’m **probably** going to apply for a scholarship.” | She is also **going to** **learn to drive** this summer. Her dad promised to teach her. | **In five years**, she wants to come back to Uzbekistan and **get a job** in a big company. She **plans** to **save money** and **buy a car**. | But her biggest **dream** is to **start** her own **business** – a small café with books. “I don’t know when, but **one day** I’ll **definitely** do it,” she says. “I want to be **successful** and **achieve** my dreams!” Her parents **decided** to help her.
